snippet.title: Mageness – Official Trailer | Eight Elements. One Mage.
snippet.description:
Eight elements. One mage. Face the endless.

Mageness is a magic survival action game. Master the power of eight elements – Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Water, Wind, Light and Dark – fuse them into legendary spells and hold your ground against a horde that never stops coming.

✦ 8 ELEMENTAL WORLDS – journey through eight worlds, each with its own enemies, atmosphere and bosses.
✦ FUSE THE ELEMENTS – combine your spells into powerful fusions like Magma Eruption.
✦ BUILD YOUR MAGE – pick new skill cards every level, upgrade your hero and gear up with legendary items.
✦ EPIC BOSS FIGHTS – every world ends with a giant boss and its own attack patterns.
✦ PLAY WITH FRIENDS – team up with up to 4 players in the Circle of Ruin, or race your friends in Element Hunt (VS).

▶ Google Play: Soon
▶ App Store: Soon

All footage is real in-game gameplay.
